source: Written by the blind job for #390 before any shaper ran. Boxes are chosen so that the verdict holds for any text face at 13 px: nine digits and commas never fit 10 px, two digits always fit 26 px, and ten characters never fit 26 px.

cases.name: a bound number in a box too narrow for it fails the fit check and is shown whole on one line
a bound number in a box too narrow for it, with room for more lines, still never wraps
a bound number with overflow spelled out as ellipsis is still shown whole
a bound number in a wide box fits
text that fits its box but not its widest string fails the fit check
the same text without the widest string fits the same box
the widest string governs plain text too
plain text over its one line is cut with an ellipsis and does not fit
plain text in a wide box fits whole
